profile.headline: Software Engineering | AI-assisted Development | Cloud & Embedded Systems | AI Innovation
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with strong experience in embedded systems and cloud software development, now actively exploring ways to make software engineering easier and more efficient with the help of AI. 

I use AI daily in troubleshooting, bug fixing, and new development, treating it as a partner to accelerate delivery and improve quality.

My career spans diverse engineering domains: developing calibration and instrumentation tools for Delphi and General Motors, building embedded systems such as bootloaders and occupant detection applications, and leading a team of 24 engineers in infotainment. I later contributed to electrical power steering at Nexteer and served as the main software point of contact for General Motors projects at Harman.

At Microsoft, I first worked on payroll and benefits systems, redesigning processes and building backend services, APIs, and integrations with multiple data sources. This included contributions to the Time and Absence Reporting (TAR) system, which at that time was used by all U.S. employees. Today, in Cloud Operations and Innovation, I design and build applications that combine Dynamics 365 with Azure services to support supplier collaboration and internal business users managing network expansions and new data centers.

I continue to explore innovative applications of AI through workshops, hackathons, and practical projects, with a focus on bridging traditional engineering practices with modern AI‑driven approaches.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer – Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I)
positions.description:
-Build applications that combine Dynamics 365 with Azure Functions, Web Apps, and other services.
-Support supplier collaboration systems and internal business applications for teams managing network expansions and new data centers.
-Deliver solutions that help scale Microsoft’s cloud infrastructure and streamline operational workflows.
-Apply AI daily in troubleshooting, bug fixing, and new development to accelerate delivery and improve quality.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer – Payroll & Benefits
positions.description:
-Designed and built backend services and APIs to support payroll and employee benefits.
-Integrated multiple health and benefits data sources to streamline logic, reporting and compliance.
-Contributed to the Time and Absence Reporting (TAR) system, which at that time was used by all U.S. employees.
-Delivered cloud-based solutions that improved efficiency and accuracy in HR processes.

positions.title: Principal Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible of the end-to-end development of production ready software for Audio Amplifier Automotive products:
-Lead the software development team (US, Mexico and offshore teams) by creating software development plans, managing customer releases, leading the software planning meetings, delegating software tasks to the team, providing technical mentoring and leading the troubleshooting activities 
-Development of embedded C code
-Development of verification and integration plans
-Lead the continuous integration (by planning, coordinating the team, peer reviewing changes, testing, approving and merging the team changes) 
-Provide project estimates and status to OEM and upper management 
-Lead internal and customer driven design reviews
-Lead in the clarification and proper documentation of current and/or modified requirements 
-Analyze existing embedded software to add features, make modifications, fix bugs, and/or port to different platforms
-Test software designs and code at the unit and system level to ensure that all requirements are met and the highest software quality is achieved  
-Coordinate and work with off-shore team and verification teams to support the development activities 
-Work with the hardware team to review hardware designs and support initial hardware debug
-Work with hardware/manufacturing/EMC/SW testing teams to define verification and testing processes
-Support hardware/manufacturing/EMC/SW testing teams in the troubleshooting of hardware-software related issues
-Communicate and interface directly with the OEM customers
-Represent the team in the reviews of the software verification and testing reports with the OEM specialist 
-Attend on site and remote meetings with OEM
-Train, develop and support resident engineers
-Lead the team in the defect management process including planning, tracking, and ensuring that defects are actively managed 
-Manage the software development process and associated work products to ensure ASPICE compliance

positions.title: Embedded Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading Electrical Power Steering Software Projects, planning the implementation of software content, participating in software development activities, driving and supporting the completion of safety related designs and documentation, mentoring junior personnel, assisting in the development and maintenance of software architectures, troubleshooting software issues, analyzing customer and systems requirements, developing corresponding software requirements, creating software designs and associated documentation, creating software packages following corporate coding standards, software verification (unit testing, integration testing, etc), working with offshore resources teams, collaborating in a global team environment.

positions.title: IDI SW Engineering Group Manager
positions.description: Oversight of 24 Engineers (plus Dextra extended team), first escalation level for Diagnostics and Reprogramming issues, on time deliveries for FCA and GM projects, subcontractor Management (Dextra Technologies Engineers), make sure all the corporate policies are followed, SW quality assurance, technical and process advisor, talent development, etc.

positions.description: Teach C++ Programming Language to the QTC engineers helping them moving from C to C++

positions.title: C Programming Language Instructor
positions.description: C programming language training, analysis and implementation of improvement forms, C programming language advisor, etc.

projects.description: OTA design and implementation from the application point of view, serialization framework development in C, coordination and integration of OTA development (PC tool development, boot-loader and application), configuration management, build process, OTA regression testing and validation, etc.
